metadata.name: Hollowmere Manor
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A gothic manor on a storm-lashed hill, and the house is armed. Levers with red lamps spring its traps on whoever stands in the wrong room: laser fences across the long gallery from the study, a balcony lever that seals the great hall and fires its spikes (the way out is through the trapdoors into the crypt), a chandelier crusher over the dining table, spike plates in the cellar corridor, iron gates in the crypt, a secret door behind the library shelves and rotten floor in the attic. Rockets wait in the crypt, heavy armour in the attic; outside, a hedge maze, a graveyard and a dead garden.

do.text: Hollowmere Manor is armed. Red lamps mark the levers: study, balcony, kitchen, cellar and crypt.
The gallery lasers can be armed again.
The great hall is sealed! Find the trapdoors...

rules.name: Great hall: the floor gives way

do.text: The chandelier is hauled back up.
The crypt gates can be barred again.
A bookcase in the dining hall gives way: there is a passage behind it!
Someone has taken the rockets from the crypt.
